test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

Julia has the habit of __comparing apples to oranges.__

options.text: Comparing two things that cannot be compared
Purchasing different fruits for different purposes

solution:
The correct answer is:** Comparing two things that cannot be compared**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"comparing apples to oranges" **means comparing two items that are incomparable or very different from each other. (दो भिन्न चीजों की तुलना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Arguing about whether painting or music is a better art form is like comparing apples to oranges.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- ***Comparing two things that cannot be compared.***
